scripts.speaker: Alora
scripts.text: Hello, I can change your headgear's color if you bring me a Mysterious Dyestuff.

scripts.speaker: Alora
scripts.text: Do you have a headgear that you would like to dye?

scripts.speaker: Alora
scripts.text:
Have a good journey adventurer!
If you ever are curious to try a new color on your Kafra headgear or the ones you found on your adventures please come to me!

scripts.speaker: Alora
scripts.text: Okay, what color do you want to change it to?

scripts.speaker: Alora
scripts.text:
Oh I'm so excited aren't you?
And just to be sure, what color is the {0} you want me to use?

scripts.speaker: Alora
scripts.text: Please understand that I'm going to use the ^FF00001st {0} of that color in your inventory!^000000

scripts.speaker: Alora
scripts.text: Any upgrades and cards will be dissolved by the mysterious dye, so be sure you are ok with having a ^0000FF+0 {0} without any cards.^000000
Ok, thanks for the warning, I think I'll give you my

scripts.speaker: Alora
scripts.text: It's best to be very sure, have a safe journey.

scripts.speaker: Alora
scripts.text: Oh my, you seem to be missing something.

scripts.speaker: Alora
scripts.text:
Looks great doesn't it?!
I hope you'll come back to dye more pretty headgears!
